review_basis: Final top-down PNG after deterministic validation round 2

review_items.concrete_reason: The south-west door opens into a fully empty turn-in area. console_serving_south_east is separated on the opposite side of the south wall, and both seating objects begin well north of the door clearance.

All four declared targets are reachable. The broad south field branches north-west to the sofa, north-east to the armchair and coffee table, and east to the console without threading between the ottoman and coffee table.

sofa_conversation_north has an open central approach with its permitted ottoman at the west seat; armchair_conversation_east has a clear south-west sitting zone; coffee_table_shared has an open south service edge; and the console has a full north-side operating strip.

The north sofa, diagonal east armchair, and offset coffee table form one asymmetric conversation group. The ottoman serves the sofa's west seat, while floor_lamp_armchair supports the diagonal chair without becoming a detached decorative object.

The primary seating mass is compactly concentrated in the north half, while the south half carries the entry route and console access. The leave-open area is continuous circulation rather than isolated empty corners, and the east window strip stays unfurnished.

A wall-backed sofa with one angled conversation chair is a normal television-free arrangement. The movable ottoman supports relaxed sitting without fixing another bulky seat, and the console gives drinks a landing point outside the main table group.

The sofa faces south toward coffee_table_shared, the armchair turns north-west toward both table and sofa, and the console faces north into its access strip. No seat points directly at a wall, door, or window.

sofa_conversation_north is the primary anchor, armchair_conversation_east and coffee_table_shared establish the secondary conversation field, and the small ottoman plus perimeter console remain subordinate support pieces.

The closest living_room_005 has a media bench and two opposed armchairs around a central table. This scene removes the television axis, uses only one diagonal armchair, adds a sofa foot ottoman and south serving console, and produces a ten-edge frozen partner graph with only 0.230769 graph similarity.

modification_rounds.manual_correction: Moved the ottoman from the armchair-coffee-table gap to the sofa's west-front footrest position and relocated the sofa access target to the clear route immediately east of the ottoman.
